designs.notes:
## Create item
- Route `POST /items` creates `{id, title, done}`.
- An empty or blank title is rejected with 422 and nothing is stored.

## List items
- Route `GET /items` returns the items in creation order.
- An empty store returns `[]`, not an error.

## Complete item
- Route `POST /items/{id}/complete` sets `done` to true.
- An unknown id answers 404.

## Delete item
- Route `DELETE /items/{id}` removes the item.
- An unknown id must answer 404, not succeed silently.
